scope: The predictor sums only terms attributed to the coarse parents actually replaced by each pair mesh, using fields from the original coarse and full-central finite response. Full-bin work includes the unreplaced part of that endpoint prediction. Each actual pair response is independently measured against the coarse mesh. Prediction errors can reflect changed fields and coupling. The pair-to-center increment follows that specific mesh path. Transmission change per 1000 added body DOFs compares these two finite mesh steps. Timing and continuum error require independent evidence. Spatial and frequency convergence remain unresolved.
